fact_text: Naya Nazimabad is a gated housing society in Karachi, built on the site of a former cement factory, with development starting in November 2011.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The project is described as an Arif Habib Group venture, with control said to rest mainly with chairman Arif Habib and his son Samad Habib.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The developing area is said to cover about 1,200 acres on leased land, which the project's representative called the biggest benefit of the site.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Amenities said to be operating include a stadium with football and basketball courts, a gymkhana, archery and horse-riding classes, a central Jamia mosque and a mosque in each block.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: At launch, plots of 120, 160 and 240 square yards were offered, with development charges of about 3 lakh PKR per plot.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: A 160 square yard plot at Naya Nazimabad was quoted at about 5 crore PKR in the August 2025 interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Limited 400 square yard plots in block A were quoted at about 7 crore PKR; the speaker linked the price to scarce supply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: A ready ground-plus-one house on a 120 square yard plot was quoted at about 3.5 crore PKR in the August 2025 interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Ready houses on 160 square yard plots were quoted at prices up to about 4.5 crore PKR; the lower bound in the caption is not clear.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Ready bungalows on 240 square yard plots were quoted between about 4.5 and 5.5 crore PKR in the August 2025 interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The FL-3 apartment project, due for delivery in about 1.5 years, offers 2-bedroom units of about 1,249 sq ft and 3-bedroom units of about 1,785 sq ft.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Apartments are offered on a 7-year payment plan with possession after about 5 years, plus a 2-year post-handover plan, an approach the agent said was borrowed from Dubai.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: A property-share product lets buyers start with about 10 lakh PKR (1 million), add shares over time toward a whole unit, and receive rental income as dividends.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent described the property-share product as offering a guaranteed return; this is his own claim and not a verified guarantee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent said a rental-replacement model used worldwide lets buyers move from renting to owning, and that the property-share and payment plans aim to make ownership affordable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: A planned hotel is meant to host residents' guests and sports teams; the developer says the north Karachi industrial area, 6 to 7 km away, lacks an international-standard hotel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The planned sports concept would host cricket matches and team training, with swimming, table tennis and badminton facilities, so teams could train and play in one place.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent said infrastructure in block M is developed and block K is under development, and that prices in both have seen good appreciation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: Buyers were said to come from North Nazimabad, New Karachi, North Karachi, Gulshan and Clifton, and the agent said residents moved from larger homes to smaller ones within the project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent said none of his buyers had reported a loss; this is an unverified self-report from a seller of the project's property.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent expects prices to rise sharply after possession is handed over to buyers, which he said is when the value of the product is properly realised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: In the agent's view, a housing project's market value is mainly realised when possession is handed to buyers, so prices often rise after handover.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The developer said bank partners improve documentation and make its products bankable, which the agent gave as a reason buyers feel secure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent credited the project's success to sponsor credibility, the Arif Habib name and bank participation, which he said shape how buyers choose a project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)

fact_text: The agent claimed Naya Nazimabad has delivered the highest continuous returns of any housing scheme in Pakistan, which he attributed to the chairman's vision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside the Real Estate Options in Naya Nazimabad | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-24)
